item_name: Rothco Come and Take It Deluxe Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco's 'Come and Take It' Deluxe Low Profile Cap combines style, comfort, and a bold statement in one high-quality hat. Made from 100% brushed cotton twill, this cap offers a lightweight and resilient construction that's perfect for daily wear. The front 2 panels feature an embroidered "Come and Take It" text along with a rifle image, providing a distinctive look that stands out. The buckram front panel adds structure and durability, ensuring the cap maintains its shape over time.
description: Rothco's 'Come and Take It' Deluxe Low Profile Cap combines style, comfort, and a bold statement in one high-quality hat. Made from 100% brushed cotton twill, this cap offers a lightweight and resilient construction that's perfect for daily wear. The front 2 panels feature an embroidered "Come and Take It" text along with a rifle image, providing a distinctive look that stands out. The buckram front panel adds structure and durability, ensuring the cap maintains its shape over time. An internal sweatband enhances comfort by absorbing moisture and preventing sweat from reaching your eyes. The adjustable hook and loop closure strap at the back allows for a customizable fit, making it suitable for most head sizes. Whether you're out for a casual day, attending an event, or simply want to showcase your beliefs, this cap is an excellent choice that combines practicality with a powerful message. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
